title.narrative: Transition to Sustainable Peace and Social Cohesion in Blue Nile

description.narrative: The Project is aiming to improve stabilization, cohesion and security of conflict-affected communities in Blue Nile by addressing the root causes and drivers of the conflict, through gender equality and engagement of women in decision-making, provision of education to school age children, building youth skills and use of environmental friendly constructional materials.
